body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. The injury remains.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Membrane (upkeep 0): your first entry into hazardous terrain each turn cannot add an ordinary Bleeding Condition. It still deals its Damage and other effects.
